camera.shot_scale_bias: flat side-on framing at a fixed distance
camera.height: level with the scene, no perspective change

lens.dof: everything equally sharp with no blur at any depth

sources: light baked into the sprites themselves
lighting.practicals: shadow is drawn as a distinct darker colour band, never a gradient

dominant: a limited indexed palette of sixteen colours
palette.grade: flat saturated blocks with hard boundaries

rules: visible square pixels with hard edges
dithered gradients instead of smooth blends
composition.movement_of_subject: animation steps between a small number of drawn poses

sound.ambience_bias: sparse synthesised ambience with short bright effect blips

music.instrumentation: A chiptune melody on square and triangle waves
music.dynamics: looping evenly with no dynamic change

must_include: hard-edged square pixels with a limited indexed palette

notes: Limited palette, visible pixel grid, stepped animation. Every soft transition is dithered rather than blended.
